# can/gen — GENERATED, do not edit

Everything here is produced by `python can/tools/generate.py` from `can/dbc/*.dbc`.
CI runs `python can/tools/generate.py --check` and fails if these files differ from a fresh generation.

The `.c/.h` pack/unpack code is produced by [cantools](https://github.com/cantools/cantools) (MIT licence, notice kept in each file).
